Internal helper: stop for a workspace object a formula reads as a variable

Source: R/classify.R
dot-jst_check_formula_objects.Rd

The formula half of ruling R19 (.jst_frame_object()), shared by .jst_check_formula_vars() (jt, jaov, jlm, jlogistic) and the front doors of jcrosstab() and jplot()'s formula path, where it comes before the refusal of a computed term so a fetched object is named for what it is.

Usage

.jst_check_formula_objects(
  formula,
  data,
  data_name,
  enclos = NULL,
  n_frame = NULL,
  term_first = FALSE
)

Arguments

formula

The formula as typed.

data

The data frame (after the pipeline's filters, where they have run).

data_name

Character; the data frame's name.

enclos

The environment the formula's other names resolve in.

n_frame

Integer or NULL; the frame's row count as given.

term_first

Logical; a computed term that gives a categorical variable is refused before the object it reads is named.

Value

Invisible NULL; stops when one is found.
